notes.title: A MONSTER update!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/6803b5dc9d91bb124c54b2a331f48e91ce09f62c.png"][/img][/p][p]Welcome back to the Abyss, travellers! The team has been hard at work on a MONSTER update, which is so massive it’s almost out of this world. It covers a whole host of new artifacts, cards, boss rewards, and rituals, as well as some balance changes and bug fixes. [/p][p][/p][p][b]ALSO, we're running our deepest discount yet at 30% off! If you haven't yet made the jump into the vast reaches of space, now is a GREAT time![/b] [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3167970/Starless_Abyss/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We’ve got a lot to get through, so let’s start at the exciting bit:[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New offerings to the Abyss:[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Ten new Counter Horror artifacts:[/b] [/h3][p]Cloned Attack: Once per turn, double the next attack[/p][p]Blood Draw: Once per turn, when this ship kills an enemy, draw a card[/p][p]Heat Mutator: Whenever you draw a card, lose 2 heat[/p][p]Recycled Energy: Whenever you draw a card, lose 2 heat[/p][p]Concealer: Once per turn, when this ship kills an enemy, enter Stealth[/p][p]Stray Missile: When this ship takes damage, launch a missile at a random target[/p][p]Revenge: When this ship takes damage, apply 1 lock onto the attacker[/p][p]Evasive Attack: After this ship attacks, gain 1 evasion[/p][p]Blast Chiller: Ship starts combat with -2 heat[/p][p]Laser Interference: Laser cards apply 1 suppress to their target[/p][p]Four new Counter Horror cards:[/p][p]One Shot: Deal 14 cannon damage[/p][p]Flanked Strike: Deal 6 cannon damage, if target was hurt, deal 9 instead[/p][p]Suppress Fire: Deal 4 cannon damage. Apply 1 suppress to target[/p][p]Disabling Cannon: Deal 4 cannon damage. Apply 1 engine lock to target[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/559ddb571e08414b53223ee038e0cc1bc3362307.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Three new boss rewards:[/b][/h3][p]War Pact: All attack cards have +1 damage[/p][p]Spoils of the Abyss: Gain 3 credits per kill[/p][p]Resolve: At the start of rift and boss combat, all ships gain 2 evasion, and all enemies gain 2 suppress[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Two new ritual cards:[/b][/h3][p]Divine Instructions : Doubles the damage of a random card in hand for the rest of combat.[/p][p]Exterminate : Deal damage equal to HP (max 20 HP)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/e19f0b52bdf2527a1ae10dcdf54bb57f5dae4f45.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Balance changes:[/b][/h3][p]A buff for Lucid: Each time a defense card is played on a ship, remove 1 heat[/p][p]A nerf for Astra’s AoE attack from 6 -> 4,[/p][p]Modifiers offering repairs for free have been removed from the pool[/p][p]Act 4: Bosses that spawn have reduced HP[/p][p]Depth changes: D3 bosses are tougher. We’ve also added a new depth modifier that reduces credits gained by 10% from boss and rift combat to D3[/p][p]Gamma emitter → Adds radioactive stacks directly instead of radioactive cloud[/p][p]Auto release -> Changed to - when heat reaches threshold,[/p][p]Dual blades -> Doubles damage for all attacks[/p][p]Increased probability of Cat Event showing up to help achievement hunters[/p][p]Launching Mines no longer exits Stealth[/p][p]Resonance buffed to +5 damage increase[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Bugs:[/b][/h3][p]Evade stacks on payload weren't getting removed at the start of turn, this is now resolved[/p][p]Fixed artifact titles not showing in shop,[/p][p]Energy spike text --> added draw 2 cards[/p][p]Fixed temporal overload costing energy when a ship has stasis[/p][p]Fixed Incorrect text when upgrading ship stats[/p][p]Overflow removes heat at the end of the attack[/p][p]Silo can now salvage the offered upgraded as well[/p][p]CleanBuild fully repairs on upgrade correctly[/p][p]Cluster mines preview shows correct damage now[/p][p]Fixed sharpshooter not using correct damage increase value[/p][p]Fixed a bug related to worm dying mid-attack from reflect damage[/p][p]Fixed quantum swap with Star Eater leading to a strange interaction,[/p][p]Fixed shooting mines with zero damage[/p][p]Slime on ship with Siren’s attack no longer causes a softlock[/p][p]It is no longer possible to click on a reward then quickly click on salvage (also the other way around)[/p][p]Fixed Flanker not showing tooltip for double damage[/p][p]Fixed Credit Card not showing correct damage preview[/p][p]Fixed Reflective Shield causing a softlock when the enemy dies mid-attack,[/p][p]When selling artifacts in shop, we fixed that the upgrade panel wouldn't refresh after credits gained[/p][p]MineField Barrier no longer softlocks when played many times[/p][p]Fixed the ship upgrade view in stores showing artifacts that have been removed, and were causing a game-breaking bug in subsequent shops[/p][p]Fixed Chrono-lock, allowing a second stasis to take effect when stasis isn't allowed due to Depth modifier[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/5ec5b9a0ca14c4c6fc94deed071a88707df901e5.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]PHEW. [/h2][p]Told you. A MONSTER UPDATE![/p][p][/p][p]The team have been so hard at work, thank you for your patience! Don’t forget to leave us a review and let us know how you’re finding all your new artifacts, cards, and rituals either here or on Discord. [/p][p]Keep safe from the whispers, wherever you are~[/p]

notes.title: Updates for 1.1.2 patch
notes.notes:
We are back with some balance changes and bug fixes in the 1.1.2 patch! 

[b]Balance:[/b]
-	Lucid buff: Many of you have said that Lucid feels very under powered compared to the others and we [i]agree[/i]. This tends to happen with starter characters but now Lucid has an extra ability of removing heat if a defense card is played on a ship. 
-	The boss Astra (giant starfish) AOE attack damage is now reduced from 6 to 4.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
-	Modifiers that were offering free repairs are now removed from the reward pool since all repairs are free now by default.
-	Artifact names were not showing sometimes in the shop.
-	Evade stacks on Payload weren’t getting removed
-	Energy Spike text updated
-	Temporal Overload costing energy when the condition is met.
-	Overflow now removes heat at the end of the attack, not before.
-	Silo can now salvage ship upgrades as well.
-	Clean Build triggers correctly when a ship is upgraded
-	Cluster Mines preview now shows correct mines damage.
-	Sharpshooter not scaling damage using the correct values.
-	Worm dying mid attack softlock.
-	Quantum Swap on Star Eater no longer causes Star Eater to “extend”
-	Slime on Ship and Siren pull attack no longer cause a bug with Slime
-	It is no longer possible to click on a reward then quickly click on salvage

Stay tuned for more updates in the future!
--
konafa

notes.title: Spoils of the Abyss Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/f3a5d41b1955466403c41c3116bd6d1a60d3691c.png[/img]

Hi all!

We're back, and we're bringing you the biggest update we've dropped so far - [b]the Spoils of the Abyss Update![/b]

This update is our first [b]major content update[/b], and we've changed the way rewards work! We're bringing you a bunch of brand new stuff, lots of FREE things, and more opportunities to earn even more rewards! Now, you'll be able to play through Starless Abyss with even more tools in your arsenal, with even more options than ever before!

And of course, we've got a bunch more bug fixes, with some balance & quality of life changes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/17e2c6f0102b76787432311b2c201edfa33fbd4d.gif[/img]
Here's what you can expect:

[list]
[*] All rewards can now be re-rolled! You can use DICE to change the rewards for both ships and artifacts
[*] All rewards can now be salvaged! Cards & Rituals will give you DICE, ships will give you HP repair, and Artifacts will give you credits
[*] In the Shipyard, you can select which ship to upgrade and you can upgrade more than one ship (credits allowing!)
[*] The free rewards every 3 combats and random encounters will only offer you cards from your factions & Counter Horror
[*] D8 is back to corruption cloud
[*] Bound gains less credits from corpse destruction, changed from 20 to 10
[*] Sentinels now have less HP, down from 6 to 4
[*] Unyielding Clutch downside reduced from 2 to 1
[*] Dweller Charging Orbs HP down from 5 to 4
[*] Repair options will now only show up if the fleet is damaged
[*] Bound Grave Robber II buffed, with +5 shield & -2 heat
[*] Bound will now receive a curse if the sacrifice option is selected
[*] RNGO & Power plan events now only require a DICE of value 1 to skip event
[*] Radiant shield now gives twice as much shield as heat cooled down
[*] Resonance card buffed with +1/+1 damage
[*] Stealth Missile now deals 5 missile damage, it won't exit stealth, and draws 1 Card
[*] Concealed card buffed from 4 to 5
[*] Around 30 cards have been adjusted to also include draw card actions.
[*] Fixed a bug where Supplemental Heat would remove all heat capacity when it's removed
[*] Fixed a bug where Tactical Mines would not give the full card count correctly
[*] Fixed a bug where Quantum Swap would not trigger the "All Over The Place" achievement
[*] Fixed a bug where Limitless capacitor had the keyword deplete
[*] Fixed a bug where Store Services would not re-enable visually after you gain credits
[*] Fixed a bug where the Red Button would get extra damage from channelling enemies
[*] Fixed a bug where cards would retain upgrade status in the run & codex
[*] Fixed a bug where Space sale and other store modifiers would not trigger in the new store
[*] Fixed a bug where Stealth Assault would target an enemy that already died
[*] Fixed issues with incorrect Chinese Translations (thank you thurvivo50 for helping us!)
[*] Fixed a bug where choosing repair before the boss would add an empty node in the timeline
[*] Fixed a bug with Astra multi hit attack not dealing damage in stealth
[*] Fixed a bug with Missiles sometimes getting stuck if the target dies while they are traveling
[*] Fixed a bug where Star Eater would softlock when there was no valid path
[*] Fixed a bug where Corruptor would softlock when the target dies while it's being pulled
[*] Fixed a bug with reinforcement waves not spawning sometimes in rifts, causing a softlock
[*] Fixed a bug with Korean text sometimes showing variables instead of translated text
[*] Fixed a bug with win conditions triggering when both player and boss die at the same moment, resulting in a corrupted run continuing without ships
[*] Fixed a bug where the achievement for Proxima unlock would trigger, but the game didn't save that the proxima was unlocked
[*] Fixed a bug when Echo's malfunction achievement wouldn't trigger correctly if you quit and resume the game later on
[*] Fixed a bug with Stealth missile targeting star eater segments
[*] Fixed a bug where upgrading a ship in the store would not give you the full upgrade (if you go from tier 1 -> 3 for example)
[*] Rewired Defense now respects threshold 
[*] Flanker now gets double damage buff for only one turn
[*] Mine Synthesizer now uses the strategy label
[*] Star Eater's tail now won't show as channeling
[*] Slime will not travel to Turrets via Sonic if it's possessing a ship
[*] Adjusted numerical values of some artifacts to give more damage/shield
[*] Act 4 Boss attack will now no longer hurt enemies
[*] Flanker double damage keyword now shows
[*] ReFocus now gives a damage buff
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/2d16078e5775d0b237b9d35029113787df9136e7.gif[/img]

Thank you for joining us on all the cool stuff we've been doing for Starless Abyss so far, there's still more to come, so keep sending in your feedback and bug reports, it helps us a great deal!

- Konafa Games & No More Robots

notes.title: Starless Abyss - Balance Update 1.09
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/d2d2dd7d88517e829805983623bc92388b02cccb.png[/img]

Hi all!

We're back again, and we've got even MORE changes & fixes headed your way, including a bunch of balance changes!

We want to thank you again to everyone who's been leaving us a review and sharing your feedback, it has been extremely helpful to us! Our duo dev team have been working super quickly to address all the feedback and reports we've had coming in, so we're super pleased we're able to bring you fast updates! The team have already put through loads of changes in such a short time, and there's no stopping any time soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/e12fd13faf8838411d862aec838f1b482221f659.gif[/img]

[b]Here's what you can expect in this one:
[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now only have up to 4 factions in your deck. As you make more card selections, the faction pool will be reduced. You will need to start a new run for this to take effect
[*] Poisoned shield energy cost reduced to 1 
[*] Energized laser upgrade damaged increased from 6 > 8 to 6 > 9, with charges increased from 3 to 4
[*] Thermal Purge Base cost reduced to 1 energy. It now has reserve keyword. Upgrade changed from -1 energy to Initiative keyword
[*] Ricochet card now works on plasma and cannon shots 
[*] Adjusted stealth missile upgrade
[*] Mines base damage buffed from 2 to 3
[*] Mine Synthesizer is a now a strategy card that gives two proximity mines every turn
[*] Ship upgrade price is reduced from 60 to 25
[*] Recon now adds 2 instead of 1 Lock On
[*] Flanker now teleports to the far side of the map but also gains double damage
[*] Zero max heat increased from 3 to 4
[*] Depth 3 will now give bosses extra health instead of minions. We found that enemy's health is too high too early in the game before you have enough damage scaling going on. If you already have an ongoing run with depth 3 enabled, it will automatically replace the previous depth implementation
[*] Kinetic stress now applies correct damage per hex moved
[*] Occult Magnetism bypassing stealth burnout is no longer possible
[*] Rewired Defense doesn't trigger more than the threshold anymore
[*] Payload is no longer damaged by events
[*] Fixed a bug where Line of sight was not being respected for Cooled Coil & Pinned Hit
[*] Fixed a bug in space sale when a second discount wouldn't be triggered
[*] Fixed a bug where QuickSilver can't stack Evasion endlessly every time it moves
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246516/78da4e479e34376b78ae065ba385f578bbe7bef9.gif[/img]

Thank you all again for the quick feedback and reports, please do keep sending them over either through the Steam forums or our [url=https://discord.gg/uQyfZZfWTP]Discord![/url]

See you in the Abyss!

- Konafa Games & No More Robots

notes.title: Monday Update
notes.notes:
Build 1.08:

Changes:
- Added possibility to disable flash animation in settings
- Ships in stores now cost a lot less!

- Ritual Cleansing buffed from 8 -> 20 shield

konafa

notes.title: Sunny Sunday Patch
notes.notes:
Build 1.07:

Changes:
- Achievements for wins will now trigger on clearing act 3 even if the player has the 3 keys to enter Act 4. You will gain the achievement on clearing act 3 immediately, if you clear act 4 then you will get the full win achievement there.
- Win Stats will increment on clearing act 3 even if the player has the 3 keys to enter Act 4. 

Fixed Bugs: 
- Sacrifice drawing cards outside of player turn
- Negator (aka shrink bug) will skip turn if intended target to teleport to has no empty cells around it.
- Achievements Enraged and Who is the horror now will no longer ignore Payload taking Damage.
- Occult Magnetism will no longer target enemies that are not possible to damage (Abyss Respite for example)
- Updated Evasion text to clarify it's effect
- Updated Severed ability text to clarify madness effect.
